name: taco
description: A single-file workspace for humans and agents to review, hand off, and manage software specs.
author: Arcadia

scripts.build: tsc -b && SINGLEFILE=1 vite build --outDir dist-single && mv dist-single/index.html dist-single/Taco_Spec.taco.html && node scripts/postbuild-compress.mjs dist-single/Taco_Spec.taco.html && node scripts/shell-gate.mjs dist-single/Taco_Spec.taco.html && node scripts/sync-extension-shell.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md README.zh-CN.md AGENTS.md docs/agent-installation.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md package.json .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md README.zh-CN.md AGENTS.md docs/agent-installation.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md package.json .github
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
